fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 500 S Pinnacle Dr, Romeoville IL - CJ Logistics America DC, a modern speculative-build warehouse in a Will County industrial park, occupied/operated by CJ Logistics (TruckMap, FDA inspection records, Birdeye reviews all cite this address).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck court on the south side is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence; the truck driveway enters from Pinnacle Dr through a fence gap with a sliding gate (visible in 2025 Street View). Controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the truck-court driveway in 2025 Street View - entry is via fenced gate only, hence remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single dock bank along the south face only; north face is car parking with no docks. Estimated ~55 doors - rear-load layout.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: False - all docks on one face (south); no second dock bank.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Row of trailers in marked drop stalls on the south side of the truck court, separate from the dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Romeoville is a dense Chicago-area logistics corridor - Urban.
